sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Care Privacy - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "While you were searching the room, have you found anything unusual? Two bodies? Such an atrocity... It can't be just a coincidence. No wonder, though, the documents that you've managed to find are dedicated to some serious research in the field of Immunology, and from what we can understand, they have made some significant progress in that direction. Judging by the signature on the documents, the research was supervised by the head of the Medical Service of the health resort. Quite an elderly person, I've met him a couple of times on Health Care Worker Day. Although he was a venerable scholar he preferred the repose of the countryside over the bustle of laboratories and often spent time in the Woods, driving around in a white minivan. Witnessing the success, I believe, could have motivated him to start experimenting on humans, the first one most likely being himself, according to medical tradition. Scientists are always like that. Find his vehicle, and, if you also happen to find his blood samples, that would be great."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the van of the Health Resort medical services director on Woods
- Take a sample of the blood
- Hand over the blood sample

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Grizzly medical kit
- Unlocks barter for Grizzly medical kit at Therapist LL2
"It pains me to think we're following the blood trail here, but I'm sending it for analysis anyway. Thank you for your work."
